title: Jan's Fishery
body:
![The Fishery Datapack Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/568d3bf68dd72266ca6f6d6a2c6d2ea73da4b1b9.png)
**Jan's Fishery is a Datapack aiming to add onto the current Fishing system in Minecraft by giving it a bit more Depth**

## Current Content
**A Slightly Tweaked Fishing Rod Recipe and 2 Brand NEW Fishing Rods!**

![The Slightly Reworked Fishing Rod Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/257d2618ad860c2d04ef172b7180a74acff659ad.png)
![The Reinforced Fishing Rod Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e490315348daed460f81e6e016bd30f9018edac0.png)
![The Sturdy Fishing Rod Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e284461c6b60fd56696e5dc46e51bc59020343d3.png)


**A Brand new Hat that increases your Fishing Luck**

![The Fishermans Hat Craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86e1c5d5872f2a525581929830b79e9670b78f2d.png)


**A Brand new Dish to Aid you on your Fishing Ventures**

![The Crafting Recipe for The Fishermans Feast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a816db32b4c3c12e14fed622bf2f3c3e0665e961.png)


**And Finally 5 new Achievments to go along your Journey to become a Master Fisherman**

![The new Achievments](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbe6f2a6a3ea9c7e2510750dc11ed6ffeafa8fc3.png)


**Planned Content:**
- Brand new Fish variants
- More Food
- Diffrent Kinds of Fishing Rods
- Reworked Fishing Loot
- Folding Chairs (Possibly)
